newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish airline LOT shows loss in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Polish airline LOT shows loss in 1996.

text.p: Polish state-owned airline PLL LOT SA showed a loss in 1996 after a 5.5-million-zloty net profit in 1995, the firm's spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
Anna Popek said she could not disclose any figures now, adding that they would be available after the company had its 1996 financial report audited later in the month.
"We will definitely have a loss but we can't give any figures at the moment," Popek told Reuters.
She said the loss was largely due to exchange rate factors and a $20-million advanced payment for its $225-million purchase of five Boeing jets purchase planned for this year.
In 1995 LOT had revenues of 1.1 billion zlotys.
Rzeczpospolita daily reported earlier on Tuesday, without naming its source, that LOT's 1996 net loss amounted to 47 million zlotys.
